title: Design Decision Record
description: Design intent record capturing why a specific geometry/element was created or modified

element_id.description: Element ID associated with this design decision

decision.description: What design choice was made (position, sizing, material, layout)

intent.description: Engineering rationale and design intent behind the choice

constraints.description: CON-NNN references that informed this decision

dependencies.description: Element IDs this decision depends on or affects

alternatives_considered.description: Alternative options considered and reasons for rejection
